name: Song of the Strider
summary: Watcher Cornelius has found signs of an unusually large lion near Terral’s Watch. He wants a tallstrider beak to make a whistle that can lure the beast out.

sections.title: A Lion’s Tracks
sections.body: Watcher Cornelius reads the markings as those of a lion, likely the leader of a nearby pride. He fears Demar’s anger if word spreads that a man-eater prowls under his watch. So he plans to draw the lion out with a whistle that sounds like a wounded tallstrider. You are asked to bring him an intact beak for its call.

faq.answer: Watcher Cornelius found markings he believes came from an especially large lion, likely the leader of a nearby pride.

faq.q: Why does Cornelius want a tallstrider beak?
faq.answer: Cornelius needs a tallstrider beak to make a whistle that mimics the call of a wounded tallstrider.

faq.q: What does Cornelius plan to do with the whistle?
faq.answer: Cornelius plans to use the whistle to lure the large lion out.

faq.q: Who might be angry if rumors spread?
faq.answer: Cornelius fears Demar will be furious if rumors spread about a man-eating lion prowling on his watch.

attribution: In-game quest text: Song of the Strider
